findings.title: Quantum Systems: Massiver Cyberangriff auf deutschen Drohnenhersteller
findings.summary_md: Unknown attackers placed malware on an internal update server of drone manufacturer Quantum Systems, a supplier to the Bundeswehr. The incident is being taken very seriously, and multiple federal authorities are involved in the investigation.

findings.title: Quantum Systems Hack: Fake Update Got German Military Drones Grounded
findings.summary_md: Attackers hid malware in a QBase software update on Quantum Systems' update server, and the Bundeswehr grounded its Quantum Systems drones while the company says its fleet is operational. The Financial Times and Der Spiegel reported the grounding on November 12, and Quantum Systems confirmed the attack that evening, saying it found the intrusion at the end of October.

findings.title: Hacked software update grounds German army drones and tests cyber exclusions
findings.summary_md: Malware planted on Quantum Systems' update server kept Bundeswehr drones out of the air and shows how one compromised supplier can reach every customer at once. The malicious file was disguised as an update for QBase ground-control and mission-planning software, and Der Spiegel reported it reached servers at the Bundeswehr and other customers but was caught in a check before reaching the aircraft.

findings.title: Quantum Systems says grounded German military drones flying again after cyberattack
findings.summary_md: German defence technology group Quantum Systems said drones in service with the German military were flying again after being grounded as a precaution following a cyberattack detected in October. A spokesperson said the fleet was operating normally worldwide, including with the Bundeswehr, which was the only customer to ground its systems.

findings.title: Cyberattack on Quantum Systems: Hackers Attempted to Infect Updates for Drones Used by Ukraine in Particular
findings.summary_md: Unknown hackers placed malicious software on Quantum Systems' internal update server, disguised as a legitimate update for QBase mission-planning software used for Vector reconnaissance drones supplied to Ukraine and the Bundeswehr. The malicious update did not reach the drones but spread to Bundeswehr and other customer servers, and the Bundeswehr temporarily grounded its entire fleet.
